issues.description: Mutating Math_unary in place via decorator complects class identity with version-conditional registration
issues.detail: The line `Math_unary = infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)` sits outside the class body and rebinds the name as a side effect. The class is now an identity carrying a registration history that depends on import-time Python version. A pure-data registry mapping function->signatures, consulted once, would separate the value (signatures) from the registration act and from version gating.

issues.description: Version-gate logic is scattered across four files instead of expressed as one fact
issues.detail: Whether `math.exp2` exists is a single fact about the runtime, yet `sys.version_info >= (3, 11)` is recomputed in mathdecl.py, two mathimpl.py files, and test_mathlib.py (via PYVERSION). The fact should live in one place — e.g. a `HAS_EXP2 = hasattr(math, 'exp2')` constant — and each site should consult that value. `hasattr` is also more honest than a version tuple.

issues.description: Removed blank line between Math_unary class and the next decorated class hurts readability
issues.detail: The diff deletes the blank line separating `Math_unary` from `@infer_global(math.atan2)`. Small incidental damage from inserting the conditional inside the module body. Restore the blank line; keep top-level structure visually consistent.

issues.description: Release note file missing trailing newline
issues.detail: `docs/upcoming_changes/10276.new_feature.rst` ends with `\ No newline at end of file`. Incidental, but it is the kind of small place-oriented detail that tools downstream (concatenation of release notes, linters) quietly trip over. One byte fix.

issues.description: Test reuses exp's x_values verbatim without exercising exp2-specific behavior
issues.detail: `test_exp2` copies the input list from `test_exp`. exp2 has meaningful integer arguments (e.g. powers of two: 0, 1, 10, -1) where the result is an exact value and a good regression check. The test works but does not express what is special about exp2 vs exp; the values are incidental, not chosen.

issues.description: `sys` imported in mathdecl.py but the gate could be data, not a version check
issues.detail: Importing `sys` to ask `version_info >= (3, 11)` treats Python version as the identity of the capability. The capability is `math.exp2 exists`. `hasattr(math, 'exp2')` removes the version coupling, survives backports and alternate runtimes, and keeps the registration logic about the thing it actually depends on.

review.summary: The change is small and works, but it is EASY-NOT-SIMPLE: a one-line capability ("does math.exp2 exist") is expressed as four scattered version-tuple checks instead of one fact. The Math_unary registration is also done by rebinding the class name from outside the class body, which complects the class identity with conditional decoration. Decompose: define `HAS_EXP2 = hasattr(math, 'exp2')` once, gate all four sites on that value, and prefer a data-driven registry over rebinding the class. The test inputs are copy-pasted from `test_exp` and miss the exact-integer-power cases that make exp2 worth testing distinctly.
